text:
maria: Quick heads-up: while debugging onboarding flow I saw unredacted PII in logs from the node sampleapp under LOG_LEVEL=debug. Looks like request IDs are duplicated and redactor is skipped intermittently.

sam: Oof. Is this the race we saw with asyncLocalStorage being stomped by libs that call enterWith? Which package versions in the sampleapp?

maria: node 18.16, sampleapp@1.4.7, deps: somemetrics@2.3.1, tracing-utils@0.9. We repro with the concurrency harness in /scripts/loadtest.js at ~40 concurrent clients.

lee: paste a log fragment? Also the order of middleware matters: our otel-hook must be initialized so it doesn't replace the ALS context used by reqid.

maria: fragment:```
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] INFO reqid=abc123 route=/v1/generate payload={"email":"alice@example.com","text":"hello"}
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] ERROR reqid=abc123 stack="Error: boom at handler"
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] DEBUG reqid=abc123 redactor=skipped payload={"phone":"+15551234"}
```

maria: middleware:```js
app.use(require('./reqid'))
app.use(require('./otel-hook'))
app.use(require('./redactor'))
```

ash: sounds like otel-hook or somemetrics is calling asyncLocalStorage.enterWith/run under the hood and stomping our map. Two quick paths: 1) move otel-hook before reqid so it sets a stable context, 2) in reqid middleware use als.run(...) instead of enterWith so our reqid is pinned.

sam: agree. Also add an assertion in redactor: if (!reqid) mark as volatile-reqid and emit a metric. We should avoid silently regenerating without telemetry.

lee: minimal patch suggestion: in reqid middleware do:```js
const als = require('./als')
als.run(new Map([['reqid', reqid]]), () => next())
```
and in redactor:```js
const reqid = als.get('reqid') || 'volatile-'+shortid()
if (reqid.startsWith('volatile-')) metrics.increment('volatile_reqid')
```

jen: QA confirmed repro on staging. I hit duplicate reqids and exposed payload lines when LOG_LEVEL=debug.

maria: opened PR #1223 that swaps otel-hook earlier in middleware stack, adds the als.run change, and emits a metric. I also added loadtest and an e2e that verifies no unredacted emails/phones at high concurrency.

sam: thanks. small ask: add an integ test that injects a fake lib that calls enterWith so we don't regress silently.

maria: good call, will add. Putting the mitigations in flight: setting LOG_LEVEL=info on Dedicated until patch rolls out: `kubectl set env deploy/sampleapp LOG_LEVEL=info -n dedicated`

telemetry-bot: sampleapp/staging v1.4.7 deployed -> success :white_check_mark: (build 8842)

ash: once PR lands, schedule a canary for 15% traffic in staging then ramp. Backport to 1.3.x if green.

sam: will review PR today and check metrics for volatile_reqid.

jen: QA will run the loadtest and e2e after merge and confirm no PII in logs.

lee: follow-up action: add a linter rule in devex repo to flag any use of asyncLocalStorage.enterWith or .run outside of our als wrapper. Saves us from future accidental stomps.

maria: noted. I'll add the linter and update changelog entry about OTEL hook ordering and the volatile-reqid metric.

ash: thanks all. Good catch, maria.
